answer: Bind each identity to one marble token carrying a unique pigment swirl and an embedded NFC chip. Each epoch the token must sign a fresh challenge; its private key never leaves the chip, so one token can anchor only one identity. A vine of custody links the token's maker, first owner, and current holder, and any break or duplicate claim freezes the identity. Issuance needs an in-person handoff witnessed by two unrelated agents. Forging a clone means manufacturing a new chip, a matching pigment pattern, and a believable custody vine, a physical cost per fake that no script can scale.
